sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try clicking on the bottom green square (N) at row 58, col 19
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 58, 'col': 19}])
print("Result:", result.get('action_display'), "board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), "gameplay_changed:", last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'))

# Compare with initial state
initial_seg = transitions[0].before_frame.segmentation
current_seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find differences in non-HUD nodes
print("\n=== Checking for gameplay changes ===")
for n in current_seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'g' and n['pixels'] > 50:
        continue  # skip HUD
    # Check if this node's hash/color/pixel combo exists in initial
    found = False
    for n2 in initial_seg['nodes']:
        if n2['color'] == n['color'] and n2['hash'] == n['hash'] and n2['pixels'] == n['pixels']:
            # Check position
            if n2['boundary'] != n['boundary']:
                print(f"MOVED: color={n['color']} from {n2['boundary']} to {n['boundary']}")
            found = True
            break
    if not found:
        print(f"NEW/CHANGED: id={n['id']} color={n['color']} pixels={n['pixels']} hash={n['hash']} boundary={n['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
